sections.section_title: ADC analog watchdog 2 lower threshold register (ADC_AWD2LTR)
sections.text_helper: Section 21.6.23 "ADC analog watchdog 2 lower threshold register (ADC_AWD2LTR)" in chapter 21 (Analog-to-digital converters (ADC)), RM0522 Rev 1, page 660.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x0B0
Reset value: 0x0000 0000
Bits 31:23 Reserved, must be kept at reset value.
Bits 22:0 LTR[22:0]: Analog watchdog 2 lower threshold
These bits are set and cleared by software to define the lower threshold for analog watchdog 2.
Refer to Analog windows watchdog section.
